purpose: Tighten the same fixed finite-record horizon contrasts by exactly optimizing a common-u rectangular/nested-selection relaxation; no population inference or new endpoint search.

known_before_freeze.primary_result: All300 marginal-subtraction/nesting-cap contrast envelopes include zero at1e-12 tolerance. Allsource baseline/time/annotation cases already inspected. Primary bounds may be loose; no fundamental nonidentifiability conclusion follows.

unchanged_inputs: Same20 scenarios, same3horizon pairs, same5common times, same fixed rosters and per-cell interval/status records as primary protocol. Refine all300contrasts, never select cases by sign.

optimization.domain: Allowed per-family selection states respect both known/unknown statuses and nesting. An upper early-path survival bound of zero forbids selected states. Other strict-positivity requirements are interpreted through closure/infima where no uniform bound on hidden branch depth is known.
optimization.fixed_counts: Enumerate feasible total selected N1>=N2>0. For each, minimize or maximize Σ_i(f2_i/N2−f1_i/N1)*u_i over u_i∈[lower_i,upper_i] and permitted states.
optimization.method: Exact cardinality-constrained dynamic program over permitted states and selected-count increments, with fixed states aggregated. Vectorization or bounded batching changes computation only. No stochastic optimizer or fitted parameters.
optimization.scope: Sharp infimum/supremum for the stated closed common-u/nested rectangular relaxation. Still outer bounds for complete biological trees because branch/fate/time constraints are omitted.

verification.before_empirical_joint_run: Independent exhaustive small rational cases and deterministic controls must match extrema. Undefined later denominators handled explicitly; all-identical path values and a single possible founder imply zero contrast.
verification.source_checks: Every joint interval must lie inside its primary outer interval within numerical tolerance; all300cases retained, no horizon or eligibility change.
verification.forest_controls: Use first12founders by fixed creation index from each of the previously fixed900-forest experiment cases, all4mask policies and bothannotation offsets/policies. Independent complete-tree truth remains unchanged; compareeverydefinedcontrast to joint bound. This subset is a computational control, not a new biological sample or a claim to have applied jointoptimization to all900founders.
verification.resource_handling: Bound working-array size or batch total-count candidates. Do not omit source cases to save computation; report operational failures if unresolved.

reporting: Publish all joint intervals, primary versus joint widths, algorithm/protocol/code hashes, exact-control outcomes and forest checks. Label this as a post-primary-results methodological refinement. Zero inclusion remains a relaxation result; zero exclusion remains finite-record only.
